explanation_en: 'Por fin' is the standard idiomatic expression for 'finally' or 'at last' when expressing relief that something long-awaited has happened. It should not be confused with 'finalmente', which is more often used for listing items or concluding a speech.

examples.en_text: At last we arrived at the hotel after such a long trip.
examples.target_text: Por fin llegamos al hotel después de un viaje tan largo.

examples.en_text: Finally it has started to rain; the land really needed it.
examples.target_text: Por fin ha empezado a llover; la tierra lo necesitaba mucho.

examples.en_text: After months of studying, I finally passed my driving test.
examples.target_text: Después de meses de estudio, por fin aprobé el examen de conducir.

examples.en_text: Finally the package I ordered last week arrived!
examples.target_text: ¡Por fin llegó el paquete que pedí la semana pasada!

examples.en_text: Have you finally decided what you are going to study at university?
examples.target_text: ¿Por fin decidiste qué vas a estudiar en la universidad?

examples.en_text: What a joy to see you, we finally meet in person.
examples.target_text: Qué alegría verte, por fin nos conocemos en persona.

explanation_en: Literally meaning 'in one's own flesh,' this expression is used to describe experiencing something firsthand, especially something difficult, painful, or life-altering. It is highly idiomatic and equivalent to the English 'firsthand' or 'in the flesh.' It is commonly paired with verbs like 'vivir', 'sufrir', or 'experimentar'.

examples.en_text: We had to experience the crisis firsthand to understand how serious it was.
examples.target_text: Tuvimos que vivir la crisis en carne propia para entender lo grave que era.

examples.en_text: I didn't believe the exam was so difficult until I suffered it firsthand.
examples.target_text: No creía que el examen fuera tan difícil hasta que lo sufrí en carne propia.

examples.en_text: She knows firsthand the difficulty of moving to another country without knowing the language.
examples.target_text: Ella conoce en carne propia la dificultad de mudarse a otro país sin saber el idioma.

examples.en_text: It is better to learn from others' mistakes than to experience them firsthand.
examples.target_text: Es mejor aprender de los errores de otros que experimentarlos en carne propia.

examples.en_text: My brother felt the rigor of military training firsthand.
examples.target_text: Mi hermano sintió en carne propia el rigor del entrenamiento militar.

examples.en_text: Until you experience it firsthand, you don't know how much a betrayal like that hurts.
examples.target_text: Hasta que no lo vives en carne propia, no sabes lo que duele una traición así.

explanation_en: This extremely common idiomatic phrase means to overcome difficulties, get by, or succeed despite obstacles. It is frequently used in everyday speech and news when discussing economic struggles, personal growth, or surviving tough times. It implies resilience and effort, similar to 'to pull through' or 'to make it'.

examples.en_text: Despite the economic crisis, my family always finds a way to get by.
examples.target_text: A pesar de la crisis económica, mi familia siempre encuentra la manera de salir adelante.

examples.en_text: After the serious accident, it was hard for him to recover, but he managed to pull through.
examples.target_text: Después del grave accidente, le costó mucho recuperarse, pero logró salir adelante.

examples.en_text: If we work as a team and put in the effort, I am sure this project will succeed.
examples.target_text: Si trabajamos en equipo y nos esforzamos, estoy seguro de que este proyecto saldrá adelante.

examples.en_text: She raised her three children alone, and they all got ahead thanks to her hard work.
examples.target_text: Ella sola crió a sus tres hijos y todos salieron adelante gracias a su trabajo duro.

examples.en_text: I know things are difficult right now, but you have talent and you are going to get through it, you'll see.
examples.target_text: Sé que las cosas están difíciles ahora, pero tienes talento y vas a salir adelante, ya lo verás.

examples.en_text: Many young people in this country have to study and work at the same time to get ahead.
examples.target_text: Muchos jóvenes en este país tienen que estudiar y trabajar al mismo tiempo para salir adelante.

explanation_en: This set phrase translates directly to 'here and there' or 'hither and thither'. It is used to describe things or people scattered in various places without a specific pattern. It is very common in spoken Spanish and adds a natural, informal rhythm to descriptions of distribution or movement.

examples.en_text: I left my keys somewhere, but I've looked here and there and I can't find them.
examples.target_text: Dejé mis llaves en alguna parte, pero he buscado aquí y allá y no las encuentro.

examples.en_text: During my trip through Europe, I worked here and there to earn a living.
examples.target_text: Durante mi viaje por Europa, trabajé aquí y allá para ganarme la vida.

examples.en_text: The sky was clear, except for a few white clouds here and there.
examples.target_text: El cielo estaba despejado, salvo por algunas nubes blancas aquí y allá.

examples.en_text: You have to organize your desk; there are papers lying around here and there.
examples.target_text: Tienes que organizar tu escritorio; hay papeles tirados aquí y allá.

examples.en_text: There weren't many people at the party, just a few groups chatting here and there.
examples.target_text: En la fiesta no había mucha gente, solo algunos grupos conversando aquí y allá.

examples.en_text: The book is interesting, although it has a few spelling mistakes here and there.
examples.target_text: El libro es interesante, aunque tiene algunos errores de ortografía aquí y allá.

explanation_en: This phrasal verb means 'to leave behind', both in a literal sense (leaving an object or person in a place) and a figurative sense (moving past a phase of life, a trauma, or history). It is highly versatile and used across all registers, from daily conversation to literature and journalism.

examples.en_text: It is time to leave past mistakes behind and look toward the future.
examples.target_text: Es hora de dejar atrás los errores del pasado y mirar hacia el futuro.

examples.en_text: Upon leaving the city, we left the noise and traffic behind.
examples.target_text: Al salir de la ciudad, dejamos atrás el ruido y el tráfico.

examples.en_text: The new phones have left last year's models behind.
examples.target_text: Los nuevos teléfonos han dejado atrás a los modelos del año pasado.

examples.en_text: It's not easy to leave behind a relationship of so many years.
examples.target_text: No es fácil dejar atrás una relación de tantos años.

examples.en_text: She decided to change jobs to leave the office stress behind.
examples.target_text: Ella decidió cambiar de trabajo para dejar atrás el estrés de la oficina.

examples.en_text: The country is finally leaving the economic crisis behind.
examples.target_text: El país finalmente está dejando atrás la crisis económica.

explanation_en: The structure 'ponerse a' + infinitive is a high-frequency periphrasis used to express the beginning of an action, similar to 'to start doing' or 'to set oneself to'. It often implies a conscious decision or effort to begin the task. It is much more common and natural in spoken Spanish than simply using 'empezar a' or 'comenzar a'.

examples.en_text: Whenever I get home, I start studying for the driving test.
examples.target_text: Siempre que llego a casa, me pongo a estudiar para el examen de conducir.

examples.en_text: Suddenly, the sky darkened and it started to rain very hard.
examples.target_text: De repente, el cielo se oscureció y se puso a llover con mucha fuerza.

examples.en_text: Stop wasting time with your phone and start cleaning your room.
examples.target_text: Deja de perder el tiempo con el móvil y ponte a limpiar tu habitación.

examples.en_text: Yesterday we started organizing the garage and found very old photos.
examples.target_text: Ayer nos pusimos a ordenar el garaje y encontramos fotos muy antiguas.

examples.en_text: The children started screaming with joy when they saw the gifts.
examples.target_text: Los niños se pusieron a gritar de alegría cuando vieron los regalos.

examples.en_text: This afternoon I have to start writing the report for my boss.
examples.target_text: Esta tarde tengo que ponerme a escribir el informe para mi jefe.

explanation_en: This is the past subjunctive form of the idiom 'dar lo mismo', which means 'to not matter' or 'to be all the same'. It is frequently used in hypothetical or counterfactual clauses introduced by 'como si' (as if). It is a crucial colloquial expression for expressing indifference or equivalence.

examples.en_text: If it were all the same to you, I would prefer to have dinner at home tonight.
examples.target_text: Si te diera lo mismo, yo preferiría cenar en casa esta noche.

examples.en_text: She acted as if it didn't matter if we missed the bus.
examples.target_text: Ella actuó como si diera lo mismo perder el autobús.

examples.en_text: I didn't think it was all the same to the teacher if we handed in the homework late.
examples.target_text: No creía que a la profesora le diera lo mismo que entregáramos la tarea tarde.

examples.en_text: Even if it didn't matter to the director, we wanted to do a good job.
examples.target_text: Aunque al director le diera lo mismo, nosotros queríamos hacer un buen trabajo.

examples.en_text: It hurt me that my best friend didn't care whether I went to his party or not.
examples.target_text: Me dolió que a mi mejor amigo le diera lo mismo si yo iba a su fiesta o no.

examples.en_text: If it didn't matter which path we took, we wouldn't need the map.
examples.target_text: Si diera lo mismo tomar un camino u otro, no necesitaríamos el mapa.

explanation_en: This prepositional phrase is used to indicate the origin, cause, or direct consequence of an event. It is a highly common and elegant alternative to 'debido a' or 'como consecuencia de' in journalistic and formal speech. It is always followed by a noun or noun phrase.

examples.en_text: As a result of the crisis, I decided to change careers and study programming.
examples.target_text: A raíz de la crisis, decidí cambiar de profesión y estudiar programación.

examples.en_text: She started exercising more as a result of her doctor's advice.
examples.target_text: Ella empezó a hacer más ejercicio a raíz de los consejos de su médico.

examples.en_text: Security measures at the airport changed as a result of recent events.
examples.target_text: Las medidas de seguridad en el aeropuerto cambiaron a raíz de los últimos acontecimientos.

examples.en_text: We became close friends as a result of that trip we took together to Valencia.
examples.target_text: Nos hicimos muy amigos a raíz de aquel viaje que hicimos juntos a Valencia.

examples.en_text: The company increased its sales as a result of the new advertising campaign.
examples.target_text: La empresa aumentó sus ventas a raíz de la nueva campaña de publicidad.

examples.en_text: As a result of reading that book, I became very interested in the history of Spain.
examples.target_text: A raíz de leer ese libro, me interesé mucho por la historia de España.

explanation_en: This idiomatic expression literally means 'on the edge of the abyss' and is used metaphorically to describe a situation or country on the verge of complete ruin, collapse, or disaster. It is frequently used in political, economic, and social commentary. It collocates strongly with verbs like 'situar,' 'estar,' or 'poner.'

examples.en_text: After losing its main client, the company was on the brink of disaster.
examples.target_text: Después de perder a su cliente principal, la empresa estuvo al borde del abismo.

examples.en_text: Their marriage was on the brink of collapse before they decided to go to therapy.
examples.target_text: Su matrimonio estaba al borde del abismo antes de que decidieran ir a terapia.

examples.en_text: If we don't take care of natural resources, we will put the planet on the brink of disaster.
examples.target_text: Si no cuidamos los recursos naturales, pondremos al planeta al borde del abismo.

examples.en_text: With three consecutive losses, the soccer team finds itself on the brink of disaster.
examples.target_text: Con tres derrotas consecutivas, el equipo de fútbol se encuentra al borde del abismo.

examples.en_text: He was working fifteen hours a day and felt that his mental health was on the brink of collapse.
examples.target_text: Trabajaba quince horas al día y sentía que su salud mental estaba al borde del abismo.

examples.en_text: The economic crisis left many small businesses on the brink of ruin.
examples.target_text: La crisis económica dejó a muchos pequeños negocios al borde del abismo.

explanation_en: The pronominal verb 'lanzarse a' followed by an infinitive means to start doing something boldly, suddenly, or without much hesitation. It carries a connotation of taking a risk or jumping into a difficult action. It is highly idiomatic and common in both everyday speech and analytical commentary.

examples.en_text: After thinking about it a lot, she finally took the plunge to open her own clothing store.
examples.target_text: Después de pensarlo mucho, ella finalmente se lanzó a abrir su propia tienda de ropa.

examples.en_text: If you want to improve your English, you have to dive into speaking with native speakers without fear.
examples.target_text: Si quieres mejorar tu inglés, tienes que lanzarte a hablar con nativos sin miedo.

examples.en_text: It's not easy for someone to embark on changing careers at forty years old.
examples.target_text: No es fácil que alguien se lance a cambiar de carrera a los cuarenta años.

examples.en_text: Next summer we will take the plunge to go backpacking around Europe.
examples.target_text: El próximo verano nos lanzaremos a viajar de mochileros por Europa.

examples.en_text: Juan has always wanted to write a novel, but he never takes the plunge to do it.
examples.target_text: Juan siempre ha querido escribir una novela, pero nunca se lanza a hacerlo.

examples.en_text: My friends embarked on buying an old house to renovate it themselves.
examples.target_text: Mis amigos se lanzaron a comprar una casa antigua para reformarla ellos mismos.

explanation_en: This prepositional phrase means 'apart from,' 'regardless of,' or 'excluding' a certain topic. It comes from the literal meaning of being on the margin or border of something, thus leaving it aside. It is an excellent transitional phrase in formal writing and debates to shift focus to a different aspect of an issue.

examples.en_text: Apart from his political opinions, he is an excellent doctor.
examples.target_text: Al margen de sus opiniones políticas, es un excelente médico.

examples.en_text: They made the decision apart from the family.
examples.target_text: Tomaron la decisión al margen de la familia.

examples.en_text: Aside from the money, this project will bring us a lot of experience.
examples.target_text: Al margen del dinero, este proyecto nos traerá mucha experiencia.

examples.en_text: You cannot act outside of the law.
examples.target_text: No puedes actuar al margen de la ley.

examples.en_text: Regardless of whether I like it or not, I have to do my job.
examples.target_text: Al margen de que me guste o no, tengo que hacer mi trabajo.

examples.en_text: She prefers to study apart from the group to concentrate better.
examples.target_text: Ella prefiere estudiar al margen del grupo para concentrarse mejor.

explanation_en: This is the standard Spanish translation for the English concept of 'accountability' or 'rendering of accounts.' It refers to the obligation of an individual or institution to explain and take responsibility for their actions. It is a crucial collocation in political, legal, and human rights contexts.

examples.en_text: Citizens demand greater accountability from their leaders.
examples.target_text: Los ciudadanos exigen una mayor rendición de cuentas a sus gobernantes.

examples.en_text: In this company, accountability is essential for the success of the projects.
examples.target_text: En esta empresa, la rendición de cuentas es fundamental para el éxito de los proyectos.

examples.en_text: Without good accountability, it is difficult to maintain trust within the team.
examples.target_text: Sin una buena rendición de cuentas, es difícil mantener la confianza en el equipo.

examples.en_text: The organization presented an annual report as part of its accountability.
examples.target_text: La organización presentó un informe anual como parte de su rendición de cuentas.

examples.en_text: Each director must participate in the monthly accountability meeting.
examples.target_text: Cada director debe participar en la reunión mensual de rendición de cuentas.

examples.en_text: Transparency and accountability are necessary for a fair society.
examples.target_text: La transparencia y la rendición de cuentas son necesarias para una sociedad justa.
